verdict.rationale: Mirrors lets teams compare sessions that received a context change against holdout groups using their own outcome labels, then keep, revise, or roll back the change (mirrors-docs-4, mirrors-docs-5, mirrors-docs-9). It also previews routing conditions against stored traces and shows per-session check pass counts (mirrors-docs-3, mirrors-docs-13). This is online A/B comparison of context edits rather than side-by-side eval-run comparison, and all evidence is vendor marketing copy. Missing for 10: side-by-side comparison of offline eval runs, comparison across model versions, explicit regression detection or diffing views, and in-depth docs or independent corroboration.
